settings.regionHint: Clusters, agents and data live in one region
settings.preflightDesc: Identity, permissions, HyperPod GPU quota and local tools (read-only)
settings.preflightNever: Not run yet for this region.
settings.projectDesc: Bucket, IAM roles and ECR repositories TuningPad needs in this region

models.checkDesc: The rollout gateway only parses tool calls for known chat templates; weights are never downloaded
models.instancesDesc: Live HyperPod prices and your 'for cluster usage' quotas
models.limits: Account limits: {{per}} instances per cluster, {{total}} in total, {{spot}} spot in total

clusters.empty: No HyperPod cluster yet. Create one (CPU system node only) and add GPU instance groups when you train.
clusters.azsHint: GPU capacity is per AZ — pick the AZ of your quota / training plan first
clusters.fsxHint: Shared storage for checkpoints, models and data
clusters.guardrailsDesc: Enforced inside the cluster by the guardian CronJob, even when TuningPad is offline
clusters.idleMinutes: Scale idle GPU groups to 0 after (min)
clusters.idleHint: A group is idle when no TuningPad pod runs or waits on it
clusters.budgetHint: All GPU groups are scaled to 0 once node cost reaches this
clusters.noQuota: No P-family 'for cluster usage' quota in this region. Request an increase or use a training plan.
clusters.createInfo: Creates the official HyperPod EKS quick-setup stack (VPC, EKS, FSx, IAM, HyperPod with one CPU system node) and installs TuningPad components. Takes 40–70 minutes.
clusters.gpuCostSub: billed only while a GPU group has nodes
clusters.importDesc: The cluster must use EKS orchestration and API access entries
clusters.importNone: No unregistered HyperPod clusters in this region.
clusters.componentsDesc: Installed and verified idempotently; repair re-runs every step
clusters.groupsDesc: GPU groups are billed per node while their count is above 0
clusters.countHint: 0 releases all nodes of the group
clusters.deepHealthHint: Stress + connectivity tests on start; adds time before nodes are usable
clusters.deepHealthOn: Run deep health checks on new nodes
clusters.costWarn: Starts billing about {{cost}} per hour while nodes are running.
clusters.confirmCostBody: Scale to {{count}} × {{type}} (~{{cost}}/h). The guardian scales idle groups back to 0.
clusters.policySaved: Saved and applied to the cluster
clusters.policySavedLocal: Saved; applied on the next component repair
clusters.deleteBodyCreate: Deletes the CloudFormation stack: HyperPod, EKS, FSx (with all checkpoints on it) and the VPC. This cannot be undone.
clusters.deleteBodyImport: Only unregisters the cluster from TuningPad; AWS resources are kept.
clusters.replaceNodeBody: Terminate {{id}} and provision a replacement with the same configuration. Its instance volumes are lost; a training run on it resumes from the latest checkpoint.

plans.searchDesc: Flexible training plans reserve GPUs for a fixed window, usually far below on-demand price
plans.confirmBody: You will be charged {{fee}} upfront for capacity from {{start}} to {{end}}. This cannot be cancelled.
plans.pickHint: HyperPod training plans in this region that reserve this instance type
plans.noneMatching: No active or scheduled HyperPod plan for {{type}} in this region — paste an ARN below or buy one under Settings
plans.arnHint: Or paste a plan ARN; it is checked against the instance type, node count and cluster AZs
plans.prepaidWarn: Capacity comes from the training plan (paid upfront): nodes start only inside the plan window and add no per-hour cost.

params.templateDefaultsUnavailable: The selected agent's template defaults are unavailable. Retry or select another agent.
params.kl_loss_coef_hint: trust region against the reference model

agents.empty: No agents yet. Start from a template such as GSM8K Math, upload your own agent, or import an ECR image.
agents.sourceTemplateDesc: Pre-built, verified agents; tweak prompt and reward settings without code
agents.sourceUploadDesc: A .zip of your agent folder with a Dockerfile; built for linux/arm64 here
agents.sourceImageDesc: An existing linux/arm64 image in ECR (≤ 2 GB)
agents.contractInfo: Every agent must use AgentCoreRLApp + @rollout_entrypoint, read base_url / model_id / api_key from payload['_rollout'], and return {"rewards": number}. It is checked statically, probed locally and smoke-tested on AgentCore before training.
agents.uploadDesc: Dockerfile at the root; the toolkit wheel is provided in dist/
agents.imageHint: Must be linux/arm64 and at most 2 GB
agents.smokePayloadsDesc: JSON array of 1–3 example invocation payloads
agents.smokeJsonError: Smoke payloads must be a JSON array
agents.runtimesDesc: Training needs a VPC runtime in the cluster's subnets; a standalone runtime only smoke-tests the contract
agents.deleteBody: Deletes {{name}} and its AgentCore runtimes. Images in ECR are kept.

datasets.empty: No datasets yet. Generate GSM8K or OfficeBench in one click, or upload JSONL / CSV / parquet.
datasets.builtin_officebench: OfficeBench tasks + testbeds uploaded to your bucket, split by task (20% val)
datasets.filesDesc: One row = one agent invocation payload
datasets.valFileHint: Optional; otherwise a fraction is held out
datasets.promptFieldHint: Payload field holding the user prompt text
datasets.explicitPromptHint: Rows carry {payload, prompt: [{role, content}]} (payload holds URIs, not text)
datasets.formatInfo: Rows must not contain _rollout (injected by the trainer). JSONL rows may be either the payload itself or {"payload": {...}}.
datasets.deleteBody: Deletes the dataset and its files in S3.

runs.agentDesc: Rollouts run on this AgentCore runtime; the trainer runs on its cluster
runs.runtimeHint: Only VPC runtimes that passed the smoke test
runs.noRuntime: No ready VPC runtime. Deploy an agent to a cluster first (Agents → Deploy).
runs.valDataHint: Defaults to the training dataset's val split
runs.presetsDesc: Verified model × instance × hyper-parameter combinations for this template
runs.singleNodeOnly: This instance type is single-node only
runs.budgetHint: Stops the run when the estimate reaches it
runs.confirmBody: About {{hourly}} per hour, at most {{max}}. Nodes are scaled up now; idle groups are scaled back by the guardian.
runs.ckptDesc: Saved on FSx; export merges one into a Hugging Face model
runs.stopBody: The RayJob is deleted; checkpoints stay on FSx and the run can be resumed.
runs.computeSourceHpHint: Managed by SageMaker HyperPod: auto-repair, deep health checks, training plans; HyperPod quotas apply.
runs.computeSourceEc2Hint: EKS managed node group with plain EC2 capacity: EC2 prices and quotas; created or scaled automatically.

exports.how: Exports merge a FSDP / Megatron checkpoint into Hugging Face safetensors with verl.model_merger on the cluster, then copy it to S3. Start one from a run's Checkpoints tab.

inference.groupHint: GPU instance group with free GPUs
inference.networkInfo: vLLM with an OpenAI-compatible API behind an internal NLB (API key), reachable from VPC-mode AgentCore agents only.
inference.deleteBody: Deletes the vLLM Deployment, its NLB and API key.

evals.how: Evaluations run your agent on AgentCore against a served model (base or trained) and average the rewards; failed rollouts count as 0.

overview.flowDesc: The no-code path from AWS setup to an evaluated model
overview.step_agents_desc: Template, code or image; deploy to the cluster
overview.step_runs_desc: verl GRPO on GPU instance groups
overview.step_evals_desc: Base vs. trained through your agent

resources.trainerImagesDesc: Built by CodeBuild from the toolkit checkout; reused by every run with the same revision

nodegroups.title: EC2 node groups (EKS native)
nodegroups.desc: Plain EC2 GPU nodes as EKS managed node groups on this cluster: EC2 On-Demand/Spot pricing and quotas, independent of HyperPod quotas. No HyperPod node auto-repair.
nodegroups.empty: No EC2 node group. Add one to train or serve on plain EC2 capacity.
nodegroups.needsComponents: Repair the cluster components first: the NVIDIA/EFA device plugins and node role are required for EC2 nodes.
nodegroups.nameHint: Lowercase; must not clash with a HyperPod instance group
nodegroups.efaHint: For multi-node training: all EFA interfaces, cluster placement group, single AZ
nodegroups.spotWarn: Spot is billed at the current Spot price (usually 40–60% of On-Demand) and can be reclaimed with a 2-minute notice; runs resume from the latest checkpoint.
nodegroups.confirmSpot: Launch {{count}} × {{type}} on EC2 Spot? Billing starts when the instances run; the guardian scales idle node groups to 0.
nodegroups.deleteBody: Delete EC2 node group {{name}}? Its nodes are terminated.
